arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. A smell of gas needs treating as an emergency, even if it only happens sometimes. Please do not use the oven, light switches, flames or anything that could spark. Open the windows, leave the flat and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If anyone feels unwell or you are in immediate danger, call 999. Please don't go back in until you've been told it's safe. We are arranging an urgent gas safety check and the oven repair, and will be in touch again today.

We are arranging an urgent gas safety check and the oven repair, and will be in touch again today.
